stem: A pump fault requires opening a guarded enclosure and isolating stored energy. The technician understands the steps but is not an authorized servicing employee. What should happen?
choices: Escalate the servicing task to an authorized role and provide the observed fault information
Perform the work because the steps are understood
Have a coworker watch while the technician services it
Remove the guard only long enough to look
rationale: Understanding the procedure does not create hazardous-energy servicing authorization. The role boundary still controls the task.
